payload.summary: MERGE 02 left three ward browser specs pointing at a route and a test id it replaced, and the lane that would catch it never runs on main
payload.detail: Found 2026-09-06 by CI on PR #2690, whose diff cannot reach ward code at all. THE DEFECT: MERGE 02 (owner-approved 2026-09-05, docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-05-ward-flow-merges-1-3-design-lock.md section 2) folded the morning bed-state board into the Capacity screen, and three browser specs were left driving what it replaced. (1) src/app/mockups/ward-flow/morning/page.tsx is now redirect('/mockups/ward-flow/capacity'), a deep-link backstop that renders no board, so tests/ui-ward-morning.spec.ts:42 gotoMorning can only time out waiting for ward-morning-page. That is two failures, at spec lines 55 and 105. (2) The capacity route renders CapacityScreen, which carries data-testid ward-capacity-page (capacity-screen.tsx:81), while tests/ui-ward-discharges.spec.ts:51 goToCapacityBoard still waits for ward-capacity-view, which now lives only in the superseded ward-management-modes.tsx:602. Measured on job 101500847557: 3 failed, 150 passed, 3 skipped. WHY IT WENT UNSEEN, WHICH IS THE MORE IMPORTANT HALF: the ui-advisory lane runs only on pull_request AND only when advisory_ui_changed is true (a mockup surface changed, or the flake ledger is non-empty). On pushes to main it is skipped - confirmed on run 34034053434, where Advisory UI shows conclusion skipped. So MERGE 02 could land with these three broken, and they surface only later, on an unrelated PR that happens to touch any mockup path. There is no main baseline, which is why the CI triage bot correctly refuses to call them green and reports 'not baselined'. PROPOSED FIX. tests/ui-ward-discharges.spec.ts:51 is mechanical: ward-capacity-view becomes ward-capacity-page. tests/ui-ward-morning.spec.ts is a decision, not an edit - the screen it describes no longer exists as its own route, so it is either retargeted at /mockups/ward-flow/capacity asserting ward-capacity-page, or retired along with the board MERGE 02 folded in. Same shape as #ZWJ71W and #YTR84P, where specs outlived the views they drove; owner is whoever took the MERGE 02 decision. SEPARATE AND WORTH DECIDING ON ITS OWN: a lane that never runs on main cannot catch a regression when it lands, only afterwards and on someone else's PR. Either run the mockup lane on main pushes, or record explicitly that mockup specs are PR-only and accept that they are found late. NOT FIXED IN PR #2690 deliberately: that PR is clinical-safety work on the calculator mockups and has no import path to ward code, so fixing this there would widen it into another owner's active area behind a design lock. Recorded and commented on the PR instead.
